item.description:
New • actvt-cli usage --json reports the Claude and Codex plan usage of the machine it runs on: session and weekly limits with their reset times, on Mac or Linux. Re-run the install command on remote hosts to get actvt-cli 0.6.0
Improved • Actvt uses about a third less CPU in the background. It no longer starts a process scan every 15 seconds to see which agents are running • With Actvt in the background, sessions show an agent starting or stopping within about 10 seconds
Fixed • The default horse icon in the menu bar showed extra legs. It runs on four again

Improved • Actvt uses about a fifth less CPU while its window is open
Fixed • Session costs left out what subagents spent, by up to 30 % on sessions that used them. Past sessions are corrected after the update • An expired licence was re-checked with the server on every network change, about once a minute • Two agents calling Actvt's MCP server at the same time could receive each other's answers, or none

New • Ports an agent left open are traced back to the session that started them, and you're told when a session ends with one still running • CPU use is attributed to each agent session • Spend is counted on the day it happened, not the day a session last ran
Improved • The menu bar icon and system sampling use far less CPU • Meaning search now covers the whole of long sessions, not just their start • Clicking a remote notification opens its session. Re-run the install command on remote hosts to get actvt-cli 0.5.0
Fixed • Codex sessions from the ChatGPT app showed no messages, and edits were missing from files touched • Sessions interrupted by an API error showed no cost • Searching for a hyphenated term, such as a file or branch name
